These synthetic QMC test vectors are from the MIT-licensed Unlock Music
repository (Copyright (c) 2019-2023 MengYX). They contain no commercial song.
See `LICENSES/unlock-music.txt`. The `*_raw.bin` and `*_suffix.bin` files form
the encoded stream; `*_target.bin` is its expected decoded payload.

The `synthetic.*` files contain a generated 440 Hz tone encoded with the
format builders from the MIT-licensed MusicKey project (Copyright (c) 2026
MusicKey contributors), with the QMC Map and KWM wrappers adjusted to match
the source implementations. See `LICENSES/music-key.txt`.
